svg.aria-label: TriageZero system architecture in six tiers: the application under test, test execution, ingestion and processing, intelligence, persistence, and presentation and review
svg.text: 6 Cloud Run workloads · 1 Cloud SQL instance · 2 schedules
UNTRUSTED — A TEST CAN BE MADE TO LOG ANYTHING
jobs as its own service identity,
so a run is never a person's
The Playwright suite, driving a real
shopfront. Exits 0 even when a test
fails — a failure is the input.
ANALYZER · ONE INTERFACE, THREE IMPLEMENTATIONS · CHOSEN BY CONFIGURATION
The verdict and the sanitised evidence it came from, in one row, so any conclusion can be audited against its input.
Survives every restart, redeploy and scale-to-zero — which a container filesystem would not.
React dashboard behind nginx. No secrets
every request it makes is authorised by
the signed-in person, not by the service.
Cron trigger at :00 and :30. No person is involved.
The job drives a real Chromium through the deployed shopfront.
On failure, failure package v1.0 is posted on a machine token.
Sanitised evidence out; a schema-validated verdict back.
Both model paths reach Gemini through Vertex AI.
Verdict and evidence written, and read back on demand.
Sign-in issues a short-lived Firebase ID token.
The dashboard calls the API with that token — never the data directly.
